description: Send Commonstop a requirement (Shared-route sharps and red-bag pickup for Dallas County offices). Your request is recorded and you receive a reference number. Commonstop reviews the prepared requirement and open questions, confirms scope and coverage, seeks provider pricing and terms, and replies by email to the address you leave with a nonbinding monthly-price proposal. Records and manifests in your office's name are a condition of the provider proposal. Nothing is ordered or committed until you agree terms in writing. Contact details are kept apart from the requirement, while we correspond or do business and for 24 months after, so a later request picks up where it left off; ask us to delete them at any time. It is answered with a receipt: keep its id and token to read its status (request_status), to add details later (continuation) and to act on an offer made in reply. A requirement is not an order and costs nothing.

continuation.description: The receipt id and token of an earlier request, to add to it instead of opening a new one
